content: Namo guru ārya-tārāyai!To the guides of the three times and their heirs,Whose generation of mind and enlightened activity are marvelous,I bow to you, Tārā, who have become the Mother,And shall explain the practice in accordance with the prescribed activities.Regarding this, since this Profound Essence is the most profound condensed essence of practice, much elaboration is not required. There are two ways: the extensive and the concise, the latter being the daily practice. For the first: In front of whatever representations of the Three Jewels are available, such as a painted or sculpted image of the Noble Tārā, arrange on a clean platform the two waters, the sensory offerings, a round white torma, cleansing water, an offering mandala, and grain for scattering. If possible, observe the conduct of ritual purification and cleanliness; if you are unable to do so, then at a time such as the morning when you have not been defiled by meat or alcohol, with the motivation of renunciation for cyclic existence and the mind of awakening, perform the refuge and bodhicitta: Imagine that the Noble Lady is actually present in the sky before you.Namo!In the Noble Lady, the embodiment of all the Jewels,I and all beings take refuge.Having generated the aspiring mind of enlightenment,I shall engage in the profound path.To accumulate merit, recite from "To the noble and exalted Tārā" up to "May I become a glorious guide." The blessing of the offerings is:Oṃ vajrāmṛta-kuṇḍali hana hana hūṃ phaṭ. Oṃ svabhāva-śuddhaḥ.The place is the realm of the Lotus Array,With immeasurable shapes and ornaments arranged,Where offering substances, produced from divine materials and meditative absorption,Become inconceivable.Oṃ vajra-arghaṃ through śabda āḥ hūṃ. Oṃ vajra-spharaṇa khaṃ.Then, first, to offer homage and offerings to the Three Jewels in general:All the gurus, victors, and their sons of the ten directions and four times, vajra samājaḥ in the sky before me.You who are the protector of all sentient beings without exception,Deities who relentlessly destroy the demonic hosts and their armies,You who know all things exactly as they are,Blessed One, together with your retinue, please come to this place.Padma kamalāye stvaṃ. (The seven-limbed prayer:) Recite from "Ji snyed su dag" through "Phyir bsngo'o."Oṃ āḥ hūṃ.My own and all infinite sentient beings’Bodies, possessions, and all accumulations of merit,Along with the four continents, Mount Meru, the sun, and the moon,And the inconceivable enjoyments of gods and humans—Manifesting as a vast, continuous cloudOf Samantabhadra’s offerings,I offer these perpetually with devotionTo the Three Jewels, the Three Roots,And the ocean of Dharma protectors and wealth deities.Having fully perfected the great accumulation of merit,May the light of primordial wisdom flourish.Oṃ guru deva ḍākinī sarva ratna maṇḍala pūjā megha āḥ hūṃ. (Thus, offer the maṇḍala.)Namo.To the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Sangha,To the gurus, yidams, and ḍākinīs,To the Dharma protectors, wealth deities, and treasure guardians—From the essence of a single primordial wisdom,You manifest everything, your nature unceasing.Your compassion and enlightened activity are wondrous and immense;You are the refuge and protector of all wandering beings.To you, the embodiments of wisdom and love,I prostrate and from my heart I take refuge.I offer my body and possessions as worship.I pray that you always protect meAnd all infinite sentient beings with your compassion.Pacify illnesses and harms,Increase lifespan and merit,And grant your blessings so that all my intentions,Without exception, may be fulfilled in accordance with the Dharma.Thus, pray for your desires. Then, specifically making offerings three times to the Venerable Lady and reciting the Tantra of Praise:In an instant of perfect recollection,I clearly appear in the form of the Noble Lady.At my heart, upon a moon disc, is a green Tāṃ,From which immeasurable rays of light radiate forth.The twenty-one emanations of the Noble LadyAnd a cloud-like manifestation of the ocean of the Three JewelsAre invited into the sky before me.Tāṃ!Within the expanse of the unborn, luminous Dharmakāya,You arise as the unceasing wisdom body of the Noble Lady,Appearing as a net of magical display to tame beings according to their needs.Come here, Ārya Tāre Jaḥ!Out of your loving compassion for me and all beings,Through the power of your miraculous emanations,For as long as I perform these offerings,I pray that you, Blessed One, remain.Padma kamalāya stvaṃ! Oṃ!With clouds of Samantabhadra’s offerings,Both actually performed and mentally emanated,Filling the vastness of the Dharmadhātu,I make these offerings to the Noble Tārā and her retinue.Oṃ Ārya Tāre saparivāra vajra arghaṃ......śabda pratīccha svāhā. Thus, invite them and present the general offerings.Oṃ Āḥ Hūṃ!The wealth and splendor of the vessel and contents of the three realms,My body, possessions, and all my accumulations of virtue,I offer to the embodiments of compassion.Having accepted them, please bestow your blessings.Oṃ sarva tathāgata ratna maṇḍala pūjā hoḥHaving thus offered the mandala specifically, recite the King of Praises and the twenty-one homages twice. Oṃ. Perform the offerings such as "Actually performed and mentally emanated," and offer the mandala as before.Her right hand, which is in the mudrā of supreme generosity,Becomes the mudrā of granting protection;Beneath it, myself and all those to be protected are gathered,And we are relieved from every fear.Visualizing in this way, recite the twenty-one homages three times. Again, present the offerings and the mandala.A stream of nectar descends from her body,Entering through the crowns of myself and those to be protected;By completely filling our bodies,All blessings without exception are received.Visualizing in this way, recite the twenty-one homages seven times along with the benefits. Cleanse the torma with Amṛta and purify it with Svabhāva.From the state of emptiness, from the syllable OṂ,Within a vast and sublime precious vessel,The torma, arising from the three syllables,Becomes the undefiled nectar of primordial wisdom.OṂ ĀḤ HŪṂ (three times).OṂ ĀRYA TĀRE SAPARIVĀRA IDAṂ BALIṂ KHA KHA KHĀHI KHĀHI (offer to the principal deity three times), ĀKĀRO (offer to the guests three times).OṂ!Please consider this sublime torma of offering and generosityWith your great primordial wisdom;Having partaken of it as great bliss,Please bestow all accomplishments without exception. (Recite this to request the desired purpose.)Perform the offerings with OṂ ĀRYA TĀRE SAPARIVĀRA VAJRA ARGHAṂ and so forth.OṂ!Of the Lotus family of Amitābha,Born from the face of Lokeśvara,Sovereign of the enlightened activities of all Buddhas—To Ārya Tārā, I prostrate and offer praise.Offer praise with "Those worthy of praise," and so forth. With palms joined:Noble Lady, together with your retinue,Look upon me with the love of your non-referential compassion;Grant your blessings so that the purpose of my prayersMay be accomplished without any hindrance.May the Buddha’s teachings spread and flourish;May the holders of the teachings be in harmony and their lives be firm;May all harmful obstacles be pacified,And may the activities of explanation and practice increase.May sickness, famine, and conflict be pacified;May righteous prosperity and glory increase;May the power and dominion of the Dharma-protecting kings expand;And may the center and borders of the realm be at peace.Protect me from the sixteen fears, untimely death,Evil dreams and bad omens,The sufferings of samsara and the lower realms, and so forth—From all temporary and ultimate terrors.May longevity, merit, power, experience, and realization increase;May unvirtuous thoughts never arise;May the two types of bodhicitta be born without effort;And may all aspirations be accomplished in accordance with the Dharma.From now until I reach the heart of enlightenment,Just as a mother does for her only child,Look upon me with your eyes of unremitting compassion,And I pray that you make me inseparable from you.Having thus offered this special prayer for one's desired aims and invoked the sacred pledge:The front-generation melts into light and dissolves into myself;Through being blessed into a state of indivisibility,My own body becomes the form of Arya Tara,Appearing yet devoid of inherent nature.Thus, while maintaining the clear appearance and divine pride of oneself as the Noble Lady, perform the recitation of the ten-syllable mantra as much as possible; finally, recite the hundred-syllable mantra and:Whatever I failed to find, whatever was incomplete, and whatever I lacked the ability to perform,Whatever I have done here, it is right that you forgive it all.Recite the confession of mistakes. Say "Oṃ, you have accomplished every benefit for sentient beings," and so forth, and by saying "Vajra Muḥ," the invited deities depart.The deity and my own mind are inseparable;Rest in the primordial state of the basic space of phenomena.Thus, sustain the view of the natural state. Recite dedication and aspiration prayers such as "By this merit, may I quickly accomplish the state of Arya Tara," and so forth.Like a wish-fulfilling jewel or a vase of excellence,You grant all desired aims without hindrance;May there be the auspiciousness of being unceasingly sustainedBy the compassion of Jetsun Tara and the Victors with their Sons.Recite such verses of auspiciousness and scatter flowers.Second, when performing the daily practice, it is best if you have a representation of the Noble Lady; if you do not, it is sufficient to visualize her in your mind. Arrange the mandala and offerings, and from the section beginning with "In the sky before me," perform the refuge, bodhicitta, and the blessing of the offerings. Since a general offering to the Triple Gem is not required, proceed from "In an instant of perfect recollection, I clearly appear in the form of the Noble Lady," and so forth. Repeat the offerings, mandala, and praises three times; after the final repetition, recite the twenty-one homages seven times along with the benefits. If you wish, you may perform the request for the fulfillment of aspirations beginning with "Noble Lady, together with your retinue," though it is acceptable if you do not. From the dissolution of the front-generated deity into light, proceed as before up to the confession of faults; there is no need for the prayer of departure. The practice is completed with the "Deity and one's own mind" section, the dedication of merit, and the verses of auspiciousness.
